bio.text: Jason Clark is the Republican Party candidate for Colorado's 6th Congressional District in the 2026 general election.
According to the campaign website, Clark grew up in the district, attended Smoky Hill High School, and graduated from West Point in 1992.
The site says Clark has been an entrepreneur and small business owner in Aurora, Colorado, for more than 30 years.
